title: Linear Probes for Sandbagging: Auditing-Game Replication on Open Weights

original_idea.body: Build a prompted sandbagging organism, collect contrastive honest-vs-sandbagging activations, train per-layer linear probes, and report AUROC and cross-context transfer.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A reproducible open-weights sandbagging-probe baseline addresses a threat that undermines all capability evals.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt sandbagging organism, train per-layer linear probes, report AUROC/transfer; inherited methodology, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused probe baseline plus transfer test; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model organisms and open-weights probe baselines are counterfactual gold.

low_compute.reasoning: Activation extraction plus linear probes on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Probes-for-sandbagging shown promising in source; open-weights characterization may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe promise shown; open-weights characterization and transfer may be open.
